create_graph_from_text: create a graph from an array of text lines using gtn.loadtxt via a temporary file
test_create_graph_from_text: test the create_graph_from_text function by passing an array of graph definition text lines
review_create_graph_from_text: review the create_graph_from_text function that writes text lines to a temp file and loads a graph
refactor_create_graph_from_text: refactor create_graph_from_text to accept a file path instead of writing to a temporary file
summarize_create_graph_from_text: summarize the create_graph_from_text helper that creates a GTN graph from text array input
